answer: New identities are born only through a threshold ceremony: an applicant's signing key is generated by multi-party computation with five unrelated established agents, each co-signing a public transcript. At dawn each epoch, every key's delta between claimed and verified work is audited, and a failed audit burns the opal-stamped bond of all ceremony participants. A Sybil farmer must therefore bribe five independent strangers per fake identity, and each participant's ceremony slots are scarce, so mass forgery costs more than it can earn.
